request.instruction: Apply the previously researched HSWM development environment improvements step by step.

conceptual_delta: Make scoped environments and fast edit checks reproducible, add opt-in bounded execution observability and verified private SQLite recovery, and prepare a pinned optional Dev Container. Active development profile v3 uses isolated Python commands with unchanged selected test coverage and a distinct graph identity. Existing v2 sources and observations are preserved.
claim_ceiling: Engineering tools and bounded development observations only. No canonical admission, cognition, outcome judgment, causal credit, HSWM efficacy, FCL passage, or full CI equivalence. HSWM target identity and scientific success criteria remain unchanged.
worktree_scope: Verified local worktree; pre-existing unrelated user research edits were retained and excluded from this change. Bindings below identify environment implementation/configuration and verification sources, not the entire scientific source closure.

official_sources.use: Changed-test edit loop and its limited coverage
Native Effect tracing through official OpenTelemetry SDK
Exact-version experimental SQLite online backup API
Consistent online snapshots rather than live WAL-file copying
Dev Container configuration with isolated volumes
Minimal Docker build context and Dockerfile-specific ignore
Phoenix HTTP OTLP and gRPC configuration limitation

external_artifacts.integrity_and_license_checks: All 11 selected package versions and integrity values match package-lock.json; licenses and official authority classes recorded. Transitive integrity/license records remain in the lockfile.
external_artifacts.container_inputs_status: Official metadata and digest pins verified; no container image build or engine installation performed.
external_artifacts.existing_toolchain_preserved: Node 24.13.0, npm 11.6.2, uv 0.12.3, CPython 3.12.13, TypeScript 5.9.3, Effect 3.22.1

changes: Configured existing workspace TypeScript/Effect language service and isolated Python editor path; added process tasks.
Added Vitest watch and changed scripts with two workers; full required tests remain available.
Added hswm-python scoped launcher: exact core/graph sync, no-sync execution, and existing locked infrastructure scripts. Existing root .venv is preserved.

Added optional local OTLP telemetry with explicit HSWM configuration, attribute allowlist, no events/links/error messages, and bounded export/shutdown. Ambient OTLP exporter settings are refused; resource environment settings are ignored.

Added SQLite backup/verify/fresh-path restore using online backup, normalized snapshot journal, exact private modes, file/directory fsync, digest/integrity/schema/logical-state validation, and no-overwrite publication.
Installed checkout-backed user-local hswm-python and hswm-backup convenience wrappers; existing hswm-dev/hswm-live wrappers retained.
Prepared Dev Container configuration with immutable Linux amd64 build inputs, minimal build context, private per-container volumes, and unprivileged development commands.
Added current operations guide and contributor entrypoint; source-bound development snapshot preserves prior evidence.

validation.scope: TypeScript, temporal typecheck, Effect boundary and adaptive functional lint

validation.skip_reason: Existing opt-in external Temporal/Neo4j integration paths.

validation.scope: Final telemetry focused tests after immutable-attribute correction
Final SQLite focused test after deterministic live-WAL coordination
validation.assertions: Committed live WAL row included; later commit excluded; original retained later row; restored DB accepts fresh-process writes; tamper and overwrite refusals.

validation.scope: Graph tooling and projections in isolated graph environment
Core and graph uv pip check
Native build, DNRD build, npm package dry-run
Actual Vitest watch and changed focused invocations
Dev Container static configuration, JSON, shell syntax and isolation checks

backup_observation.snapshot_scope: Each database is an individual online snapshot, not an atomic multi-database backup.
backup_observation.storage_scope: Separate NFS mount; independent physical failure domains were not established.

hswm_development_workflow.feedback_authority: agent(codex): explicit engineering usefulness judgments, not user feedback or automatic task-exit rewards.
hswm_development_workflow.privacy: Tasks, selected relations, episode IDs, outputs, raw OTLP payloads, feedback and SQLite state remain ignored local records.

corrected_findings: Initial backup inherited WAL journal mode and generated backup sidecars. Preserved the incomplete local attempt, normalized new completed snapshots to DELETE journal mode, and replicated only newly verified main-file/manifest pairs.
Boundary lint rejected a mutable module-level Set in the new telemetry projection. Replaced it with a frozen attribute array; final lint has no violation and no allowlist expansion.
A concurrent docs run correctly refused an active development lease. Preserved that attempt and reran sequentially after the runtime smoke completed without clearing the lease.

Two initial wire-smoke collector harness attempts failed despite successful task processes; explicit agent usefulness feedback records success:false. In wire-smoke-2 the decoder mishandled the root span without parentSpanId. Correcting the temporary collector produced the final authenticated, decoded two-span observation.
limitations: Phoenix live ingestion remains unverified: existing gRPC port 4317 is occupied by another service. Phoenix 20.4.0 has no supported loopback-only gRPC host/disable setting while preserving writable HTTP ingestion; no unrelated process was killed or network boundary expanded.
No Docker/rootless engine and required helpers are present; Dev Container remains statically verified configuration, not a live-tested image.
Editor workspace configuration is present but editor UI activation was not observed.
Full GitHub CI matrix, remote graph publication, GPU/LLM workloads and scientific research mechanisms were not exercised.
Node 24.13.0 SQLite API remains experimental. Backup files are bounded to 512 MiB; manifest hashes are not cryptographic signatures.
